eslint.config.mjs: Loaded by the lint gate; it configures ESLint rather than application behavior.
scripts/capture_screenshots.mjs: Browser capture entry point requiring the installed WASM and live rendering; screenshot-gallery validates its artifacts and the capture helpers have unit tests.
scripts/count_assertions.mjs: Preloaded before its own loader hook exists; runner negative tests verify assertion counting and the module roster rejects absent records.
scripts/generate_promoted_shader_documen: Generator entry point requiring the compiled engine catalog; patterns-provenance runs its check mode and promoted_digests.test.mjs validates document identities.
scripts/report_cases.mjs: Runs in the node:test reporter process outside test-loader instrumentation; run_tests.test.mjs exercises its case tallies through subprocesses.
scripts/run_tests.mjs: Outer command-line runner executes outside test context; run_tests.test.mjs exercises accepted and rejected subprocess runs.
scripts/shader_workbench_cli.mjs: Command-line dispatcher around shader_workbench.mjs; schema, validation and emission helpers are unit tested, while CI drives the CLI generation/check paths.
scripts/wasm_smoke.mjs: Integration entry point requiring the compiled WASM engine; the wasm CI job runs it and wasm_smoke_predicates.test.mjs covers its pure predicates.
